metadata.title: Will AAP make a dent in tribal areas of Gujarat | गुजरात के आदिवासी केजरीवाल पर कितना भरोसा करेंगे?
metadata.description: Aam Adami Party (AAP) is successful in creating a buzz in Gujarat election. Now prime minister Narendra Modi is making reference about AAP leaders in his speeches there. It's believed that without winning tribal voters heart, it will not be possible for AAP or Congress to defeat BJP. So AAP has made several promises to the adivasis in the state.
